answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a lagoon index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the ocean index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the vine audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 175 aliases thus needs 175 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
